anchor_source: Legionellabesluit Art. 1 18° (hospital = high-risk establishment, scope high, Art. 4–10); 45 °C lies in the growth range 25–50 °C (HSG274 Part 2 §2.3; DVGW W 551 §6: store outlet >= 60 °C) -> a hand assessor rates a hospital store at 45 °C at least HIGH
Hand: copper EN 1057 28x1.5 -> d = 25 mm; V = pi/4 * 0.25^2 dm2 * 98 dm = 4.81 L > 3 L (DVGW W 551 §5.3 3-litre rule); 200 aerosol points at a hospital -> at least HIGH
Legionellabesluit Art. 18: moderate-risk establishment with never more than 40 persons/day is exempt from Art. 13–17 only; Art. 11 (BBT for new installations) and Art. 12 (renovation) still apply
Legionellabesluit Art. 16 §2: >= 30 % of the samples > 10 000 KVE/l in a moderate-risk establishment -> monthly sampling (3 of 10 = 30 %)
Legionellabesluit Art. 9 §2: high-risk establishment, >= 30 % of the samples > 1 000 KVE/l -> heightened vigilance
VDI/DVGW 6023-1 (2022) §4.3 / DVGW W 551: complete water exchange at least every 72 h -> flushing task every 3 days
DVGW W 551 (2004) §3: large installation = store > 400 L or > 3 L in a pipe run between heater outlet and draw-off point
DVGW W 551 (2004) §3: installations in one- and two-family houses are small installations, whatever the store and pipe volume

Legionellabesluit Art. 1 35°: a watervoorziening excludes only 'de systemen waarop alleen toiletten of wastafels zonder douchesystemen aangesloten zijn' -> a hospital system with a whirlpool/spa is covered; Art. 1 18° -> high
METHOD input rules: yes/no inputs are true/false (1/0, 'true'/'false', '1'/'0'); 'yes' is an input error, never false

Legionellabesluit Art. 9 §4 3° (3 of 10 = 30 % > 100 000 KVE/l -> melding) and §5: 1° 'brengt de afdeling Toezicht Volksgezondheid onmiddellijk op de hoogte en het gebruik van aerosolproducerende installaties wordt stopgezet'; 2° measures in consultation; 3° restart only when representative samples < 100 000 KVE/l; 4° 'minstens gedurende drie maanden gevolgd volgens een intensief staalnameplan' (codex.vlaanderen.be DID 1015749, read 06.11.2026)

Legionellabesluit Art. 16 §3 (moderate risk): notify the Afdeling Toezicht Volksgezondheid at once, inform the users and advise susceptible persons not to use it, measures in consultation, out of service if not < 100 000 KVE/l one month after the report; no immediate stop of aerosol use in this article

VDI 6023: 'sämtliches in einer Trinkwasser-Installation enthaltene Wasser [muss] nach spätestens 72 Stunden ausgetauscht sein' (vdi.de, read 06.11.2026) -> an outlet idle 4 d > 3 d is stagnant; flushing every 3 d
DVGW: 'Das erwärmte Trinkwasser am Ausgang des zentralen Trinkwassererwärmers muss 60 °C haben' (dvgw.de Heizungsraum) -> 57 °C fails W 551 even though it meets a user target of 55 °C
